title: Optic Nerve
description: Season ten of Focus Cast by focuslinks opens the final season, Neuroanatomy for Optometrists, and starts at the true beginning of the visual pathway. Meet the optic nerve through its fibre composition: about one point two million axons born in retinal ganglion cells, gathered across the retina as a transparent veil and insulated into brain white matter behind the eye. Learn the three great streams of fibres that carry detail, motion and colour, plus the small light-sensitive set that drives the pupil, and take a first look at the partial crossing that lies ahead. An anatomy-first episode for optometry students, optometrists and the whole eye care team.
